governance.ceo_total_comp_note: SCT Summary Compensation Table FY2025 = $22,569,085 (proxy DEF14A FY2025, filed October 2025). Composé de : salary $800,000 + bonus $1,015,200 + stock awards $20,750,885 + other $3,000. En baisse 55.9% vs FY2024 ($51.14M). Nutanix fiscal year se termine fin juillet.
governance.board_independence_note: 8 directors indépendants sur 9 (88.9%). Seul Ramaswami non-indépendant (CEO). Chair of the Board indépendant. Audit, Compensation, Nominating & Corporate Governance, et Security & Privacy Committees tous 100% indépendants.
governance.board_women_note: 2 femmes sur 9 board members (22.2%) selon proxy 2025.
governance.top_capital_note: Capital largement institutionnel, free float quasi-total. Fidelity actionnaire dominant.
